title: Euclid's Elements
description: Five postulates, a compass and a straightedge, and from them every triangle, circle and solid of the old geometry. Unlocks the Geometer's Table.

puzzle.goal: A triangle has sides a and b with the angle C between them. Write Q, the square of the third side.
puzzle.name: Law of cosines
puzzle.form: a ^ 2 + b ^ 2 - 2 * a * b * cos ( C )
puzzle.expr: a ^ 2 + b ^ 2 - 2 * a * b * cos ( C )
puzzle.ask: Find Q for a = 3, b = @{b} and C = @{C} rad (a right angle).
puzzle.method: Drop a perpendicular from the far corner and use Pythagoras twice; at a right angle cos C = 0 and it is Pythagoras.
